record.body:
## Problem

Interaction-level bugs escaped because tests ran at the wrong evidence level. A unit test can fail at base and pass at head while the feature is still broken.

## Approach

Adopt `evidence-kind-enforcement`: claims declare `evidence_kind` (`unit`|`integration`|`interaction`); verdict refuses disallowed runner templates for that kind; ship an interaction template for the pass fixture. Phase-end reviewer skipped.

## Exit criteria

- Interaction claim on default unit runner fails.
- Interaction claim on interaction template can pass.

## Landing

- **branch:** `phase/evidence-kind`
- **worktree:** `/home/andrewyin/affidavit--evidence-kind`
- **base:** `main`
- **close:** commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into `main`; commit the store on the primary checkout
- **push:** not a stop (do not push)

## Run

One sitting. No human stops. Wave 1 is the single task `kind-enforcement` (`subagent`, 18 minutes). Wave 2 is `verify-evidence-kind` (`inline`, 5). Phase elapsed is 23 minutes.

Collision notes: one implementation task owns `affidavit/evidence_kind.py`, `affidavit/manifest.py`, `affidavit/verdict.py`, and `affidavit/cli.py`; `tests/test_evidence_kind.py` is frozen. Plan-review answered at once under the campaign pre-approval.

payload.title: Claims declare evidence_kind and verdict enforces it
